directions: All six ordered donor-recipient pairs across MUSA/CASY/ATD
checkpoint: Final recipient pre-report date-only cutoff, donor strictly published before recipient report; unchanged existing replay selection and training
overlap: Donor/recipient actual calendar overlap divided by recipient calendar-period length, exposure proxy not gallons; HIGH >=0.50, LOW positive <0.50, NO_OVERLAP blocked
models: NO_UPDATE baseline; FIXED_UPDATE baseline +0.5*overlap-weighted own-basis donor surprise; FITTED_UPDATE baseline +0.5*existing bounded through-origin ridge loading*same surprise
fitted_rule: Unchanged original replay penalty10, loading[0,1], minimum8 earlier published same-regime recipient residual pairs; do not fit overlap bins separately
comparison: Primary no/fixed/fitted comparison on identical fitted-eligible targets; separately disclose fixed coverage without fitted eligibility, zero-loading/no-move states and exclusion counts
groups: All and modern period start>=2021, each with all/high/low overlap groups; preserve original baseline >=5c and ordinary groups
concentration: Descriptive leave-one-quarter-out scoring of already frozen predictions, no refit: drop each row, worst remaining mean improvement, largest positive contributor, improvement after dropping it, share of positive gains; also remove all originally >=5c cases
selection: No thresholds/penalties/weights retuned, no winner auto-selected across six directions/bins, no promotion from subgroup results
